errors.text_span: 这些类别按字母顺序排列
errors.evidence: The categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted alphabetically. They are sorted in descending order based on their percentage values.
The vertical axis does not have visible tick marks or scale labels, so the claim that the scale interval is 1% is fabricated.

errors.text_span: 其训练集、验证集和测试集的比例均为31.6%
errors.evidence: For the category '空间实体', the values are 31.6%, 31.3%, and 31.6%. They are not all 31.6%.

errors.text_span: “场所”类别的柱状图高度最低
errors.evidence: The bars for the '场所' (Location) category are the third highest, not the lowest. The lowest bars are for categories on the far right, such as '隐式距离' (Implicit Distance).
The chart shows the value for the validation set ('验证集') in the '场所' (Location) category is 19.1%, not 19.3%.
